src/lib.rs:
```rust
use proc_macro::TokenStream;
use proc_macro2::TokenStream as TokenStream2;
use quote::quote;
use syn::{parse_macro_input, DeriveInput};

#[proc_macro_derive(Greet)]
pub fn derive_greet(input: TokenStream) -> TokenStream {
    expand_greet(input.into()).into()
}

pub fn expand_greet(input: TokenStream2) -> TokenStream2 {
    let input = syn::parse2::<DeriveInput>(input).expect("...");
    let name = &input.ident;
    quote! {
        impl #name {
            pub fn greet(&self) -> String {
                format!("Hello from {}!", stringify!(#name))
            }
        }
    }
}
```
